title: 章一 成长
slug: 罪恶之城全本免费-罪恶之城最新章节列表
content_zh:
这是一个让人欣喜的季节，经过漫长的寒冬，人们终于可以开始新的一年，不必忍受酷寒，食物更容易获取，品种也慢慢变得丰富。所以冬去春来时，都是一年中最重要的节日，不止是人类，矮人、兽人、精灵甚至是食人魔都把最重要的庆典放在春天。当然，世界是如此复杂，总会有例外，比如说地下世界的居民们，春天对他们就几乎没有意义。例外可以发展到极端，比如雪妖，这个种族最痛恨的就是春天。不管怎么说，对于大多数人类来说，春天总是让人愉悦的。
当温暖而湿润的气流艰难地翻越了海岸山脉，抵达鲁瑟兰村的时候，村中人们就知道，春天又到了。
鲁瑟兰座落于海岸山脉脚下，是这座绵延万里的巨大山脉中很不起眼的一个小点，也是数以万计的人类聚居地中的一个。这里隶属于塔克男爵领，也是神圣同盟帝国的领土。可是即便以直线距离计算，塔克男爵的城堡距离这里也有将近三百多公里。只有每年秋季收获时，村里的人们才会看到男爵的税官。也只有在这个时候，领主才有了微不足道的存在感。男爵的税很轻，只是收些山里特有的土产而已，对村民们的日常生活几乎看不到什么影响。不过村子的产出有限，如果税收影响再大一些，就会涉及到生存问题了。
山里的生活其实不算艰难，只要一年辛勤劳作到头就行。
春天一到，村外的土地就需要翻种，播种下夏天就可以收获的粮食。猎人们则开始进入森林，这个时节，森林深处那些饿了一冬的魔兽逐渐醒来，开始觅食。它们变得十分危险，并极具攻击性。但是一些魔兽身上的特产，比如说某些可以用作珍贵药材或者是香料的腺体，只有在这个时候成色最好，也才能够卖出最高的价钱。每年的这个季节，猎人们都会有死伤，但是年年猎人们都会照常进山。所以在鲁瑟兰村，森林与狩猎女神得到的信仰最多，要知道，除了永恒之龙外，诺兰德大陆上的神明和信仰可是多如头顶的星辰。
诺兰德大陆是物产丰饶的土地，是崇尚力量的土地，也是等级森严的土地。
即使鲁瑟兰这样一个偏远而宁静的村落，也深深打上了年代的烙印。村民们质朴诚挚，但也同样尊重强者，鄙视弱小。仅有几十户的小村庄，却也有着隐然的等级高下。
村外出现了一个小小的身影，这是一个男孩，背上却背着和自己差不多高的箩筐，里面装满了面包果。在春天，一冬的储备已基本消耗殆尽，而新的作物尚未到收获的时候，这种味道并不怎么样的果实可是很重要的口粮。它很容易获得，只要到村旁的树林中去捡就好了。
在小男孩身后，三个比他要整整高出一头的少年结伴出现。他们手里提着的是猎弓短叉，腰中还别着短刀，身后背着鹿和兔子等猎物。他们虽然年纪还不到十岁，却也能进山打猎了。他们的猎物当然不是魔兽，而是一些温驯的动物，捕猎的途径也主要是依靠陷阱，可是这已经很不容易了。城镇中的平民和贵族子弟，这个时候多半还在父母羽翼下学习和修炼。
为首的少年忽然高声叫着：“嗨，李察，你的父亲呢？他没教你捕猎吗？我在你的年纪，可是已经一个人进山设陷阱抓兔子了呢！”
旁边一个男孩附和的笑着，说：“没爹的孩子只会捡果子！”
三个大男孩哈哈笑着，越过了小男孩，向村子里奔去，步履轻松，一点也看不出每个人都提了几十公斤的猎物。小男孩没有理会嘲笑，而是继续背着自己的箩筐向村里走去。一个坐在村口的中年壮汉早把一切都看在了眼底，他向小男孩招了招手，叫了过来，然后把一块风干的魔兽肉干塞在男孩的手里，怜爱的揉了揉他的头，问：“小李察，皮鲁他们这样欺负你，你不生气吗？回头大叔就去教训他们一顿，就算是小孩子，说话也不能太过分。”
没想到小男孩摇了摇头，说：“不用了，我没有生气。”
“可是……”男人用粗糙黝黑的大手抓了抓自己的头发，有些难以理解，还以为他是怕了那几个大男孩，忍不住就想要说几句。山里的孩子，什么都可以缺，就是不能缺乏勇气。

content_en:
This is a joyful season. After a long cold winter, people can finally start a new year without having to endure the severe cold. Food is easier to obtain and the variety is slowly becoming richer. So when winter turns to spring, it is the most important festival of the year. Not only humans, but dwarves, orcs, elves and even ogres all hold their most important celebrations in spring. Of course, the world is so complex that there are always exceptions, such as the residents of the underground world, for whom spring has almost no meaning. Exceptions can be developed to extremes, such as the Snow Demon. What this race hates most is spring. Regardless, spring is always a joy for most humans.
When the warm and moist air flow arduously crosses the coastal mountains and reaches the village of Russelan, the people in the village know that spring has arrived again.
Rutheran is located at the foot of the Coast Mountains. It is an inconspicuous small point in this huge mountain range that stretches thousands of miles. It is also one of tens of thousands of human settlements. This place belongs to the Baron of Tucker and is also the territory of the Holy Alliance Empire. But even in terms of straight-line distance, Baron Tucker's castle is nearly three hundred kilometers away from here. The baron's tax collector is only seen by the people in the village every autumn during the harvest. Only at this time did the lord have a negligible sense of existence. The baron's tax was very light, and he only collected some local products unique to the mountains. It had little impact on the daily life of the villagers. However, the village's output is limited. If the tax impact is greater, it will involve survival issues.
Life in the mountains is actually not difficult, as long as you work hard for a year.
As soon as spring arrives, the land outside the village needs to be plowed and planted with food that can be harvested in the summer. Hunters began to enter the forest. At this time, the monsters deep in the forest that had been hungry for the whole winter gradually woke up and began to look for food. They become very dangerous and aggressive. However, some special products of Warcraft, such as certain glands that can be used as precious medicinal materials or spices, can only be sold at the highest price when they are in the best quality at this time. At this season every year, hunters will suffer casualties, but every year hunters will go into the mountains as usual. Therefore, in Rutheran Village, the goddess of forest and hunting has the most faith. You must know that, except for the Eternal Dragon, there are as many gods and faiths on the continent of Norland as there are stars above our heads.
The continent of Noland is a land with abundant products, a land that advocates strength, and a land with strict hierarchy.
Even a remote and peaceful village like Russelan is deeply marked by the times. The villagers are simple and sincere, but they also respect the strong and despise the weak. There are only a few dozen households in a small village, but there is also an obvious hierarchy.
A small figure appeared outside the village. He was a boy, carrying a basket about the same height as himself, filled with breadfruit. In spring, when the winter reserves have been basically exhausted and new crops have not yet been harvested, this fruit, which does not taste very good, is a very important food ration. It's easy to get, just go to the woods next to the village and pick it up.
Behind the little boy, three teenagers who were a full head taller than him appeared together. They were carrying hunting bows with short forks in their hands, and daggers in their waists. They carried deer, rabbits and other prey behind their backs. Although they are less than ten years old, they are still able to go hunting in the mountains. Of course, their prey is not Warcraft, but some tame animals, and their hunting method mainly relies on traps, but this is no longer easy. Most of the civilians and aristocratic children in the towns were still studying and practicing under the wings of their parents at this time.
The leading boy suddenly shouted loudly: "Hey, Richard, where is your father? Didn't he teach you how to hunt? When I was your age, I went into the mountains to set traps and catch rabbits by myself!"
A boy next to him smiled in agreement,Said: "A child without a father can only pick up fruit!"
The three big boys laughed, passed the little boy, and ran towards the village. They walked easily, and it was not obvious that each of them was carrying dozens of kilograms of prey. The little boy ignored the ridicule and continued walking towards the village carrying his basket. A middle-aged man sitting at the entrance of the village had already seen everything. He waved to the little boy and called him over. Then he put a piece of dried Monster meat into the boy's hand, rubbed his head lovingly, and asked: "Little Richard, Piru and the others bully you like this, aren't you angry? I will teach them a lesson later. Even if you are a child, you can't speak too much."
Unexpectedly, the little boy shook his head and said, "No, I'm not angry."
"But..." The man scratched his hair with his rough, dark hands. It was a little hard to understand. He thought he was afraid of those big boys, so he couldn't help but want to say a few words. Children in the mountains can lack everything but courage.
